Compute Dose-Volume Histogram (DVH) and Clinical Radiation Metrics

Source: R/rt-dose.R
dicom_dvh.Rd

Evaluates cumulative and differential Dose-Volume Histograms (DVHs) and extracts key radiation oncology clinical metrics (D95, D90, D50, V20, min, max, and mean dose) across ROIs from an RTDOSE volume and a dicom_seg mask.

Usage

dicom_dvh(dose, seg, n_bins = 100L)

Arguments

dose

An RTDOSE dicom_volume or path to a DICOM RTDOSE file.

seg

A dicom_seg segmentation object containing one or more ROIs.

n_bins

Number of dose bins for the histogram curves. Default is 100L.

Value

An object of class "dicom_dvh" containing:

metrics

A tibble with clinical metrics per ROI (roi_number, roi_label, volume_cc, min_dose, max_dose, mean_dose, D95, D90, D50, V20).

curves

A tibble of dose evaluation points with cumulative (vol_pct_cumulative) and differential (vol_pct_differential) volumes.

Examples

synth <- dicom_synthesize(modality = "CT", dims = c(32L, 32L, 5L))
vol <- read_dicom_volume(synth[["out_dir"]])
unlink(synth[["out_dir"]], recursive = TRUE)
